vo_lines.transcript: STOP! Stop right there! Do you have ANY idea how long it takes to grow a scout?!
Wait. Wait, wait, wait. Your gun is cold. Why is your gun cold?!
The last cold gun was zero one two one. Oh. Oh, no. You're the next number.
I am the Warden! I keep these lanes! And I am SO TIRED of saying that!
You're not shooting. You are not SHOOTING. Is this a trick? Is it a trick?!
